name: Qwen3.8-Plus
archDisplay: API-only mid tier of the Qwen3.8 line (hybrid linear/full-attention stack shared with the open 27B); undisclosed parameter count, 1M-token context
note: Alibaba's September 9, 2026 mid-tier API model, slotted between Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and the flagship 0902 Max refresh — the hosted counterpart to the open 27B weights. Priced at $0.80/$2.40 per Mtok, roughly 2.5x below the Max, with the same 1M context. Launch table is entirely vendor-run (Qwen's own harness); it leads the open 27B across the board but trails the Max by 3-5 points on the shared rows, matching the historical Plus-vs-Max gap. Video-MME Pro row is the first filing on that benchmark revision for this catalog — Qwen is the only vendor citing it so far.
